description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CreditScoringRequest" name="Credit scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringRequest" name="Credit scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Level1ScoringResult" name="Level 1 credit scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Level2ScoringResult" name="Level 2 credit scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringResultToClerk" name="Credit scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CheckAgainLaterToClerk" name="Message to check again later"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FinalScoringResultToClerk" name="Final credit scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SalesClerk" name="Sales Clerk (Frontend)" processRef="Process_SalesClerk"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Banking" name="Banking System" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ClerkRequest" name="Credit scoring request" sourceRef="SendTask_ClerkRequest" targetRef="Start_CreditScoringRequested" messageRef="Msg_CreditScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ScoringRequest" name="Credit scoring request" sourceRef="SendTask_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Start_ScoringRequestReceived" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Level1Result" name="Level 1 credit scoring result" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLevel1Result" targetRef="Catch_Level1Result" messageRef="Msg_Level1ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="SendTask_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotice" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Level2Result" name="Level 2 credit scoring result" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Catch_Level2Result" messageRef="Msg_Level2ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ScoringResultToClerk" name="Credit scoring result" sourceRef="SendTask_PresentResult" targetRef="Participant_SalesClerk" messageRef="Msg_ScoringResultToClerk"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CheckAgainToClerk" name="Check again later" sourceRef="UserTask_DisplayDelay" targetRef="Participant_SalesClerk" messageRef="Msg_CheckAgainLaterToClerk"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FinalResultToClerk" name="Final credit scoring result" sourceRef="SendTask_PresentFinalResult" targetRef="Participant_SalesClerk" messageRef="Msg_FinalScoringResultToClerk"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SalesClerk" name="Sales Clerk Frontend" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ClerkStarts" name="Clerk starts credit scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ClerkRequest" name="Send credit scoring request for customer" messageRef="Msg_CreditScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RequestSent" name="Request sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClerkStartToRequest" sourceRef="Start_ClerkStarts" targetRef="SendTask_ClerkRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClerkRequestToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_ClerkRequest" targetRef="End_RequestSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking System Credit Scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CreditScoringRequested" name="Credit scoring requested by clerk">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CreditScoringRequest" messageRef="Msg_CreditScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendScoringRequest" name="Send credit scoring request to agency" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AgencyReply" name="Immediate result or delay notice?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Level1Result" name="Level 1 credit scoring result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Level1Result" messageRef="Msg_Level1ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DelayNotice" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_PresentResult" name="Present credit scoring result to clerk" messageRef="Msg_ScoringResultToClerk"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ResultPresented" name="Result presented"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_DisplayDelay" name="Display message to clerk to check again later"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Level2Result" name="Level 2 credit scoring result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Level2Result" messageRef="Msg_Level2ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_PresentFinalResult" name="Present final credit scoring result to clerk" messageRef="Msg_FinalScoringResultToClerk"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FinalResultPresented" name="Final result presented"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSend" sourceRef="Start_CreditScoringRequested" targetRef="SendTask_SendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendToGateway" sourceRef="SendTask_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_AgencyReply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatewayToLevel1Result" sourceRef="Gateway_AgencyReply" targetRef="Catch_Level1Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatewayToDelayNotice" sourceRef="Gateway_AgencyReply" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Level1ResultToPresent" sourceRef="Catch_Level1Result" targetRef="SendTask_PresentResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PresentToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_PresentResult" targetRef="End_ResultPresented"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayNoticeToDisplay" sourceRef="Catch_DelayNotice" targetRef="UserTask_DisplayDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisplayToLevel2" sourceRef="UserTask_DisplayDelay" targetRef="Catch_Level2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Level2ToPresent" sourceRef="Catch_Level2Result" targetRef="SendTask_PresentFinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PresentFinalToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_PresentFinalResult" targetRef="End_FinalResultPresented"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ScoringRequestReceived" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Level1Outcome" name="Immediate result available?" default="Flow_LevelOneNotImmediate"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendLevel1Result" name="Send level 1 credit scoring result" messageRef="Msg_Level1ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level1ResultSent" name="Level 1 result sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendDelayNotice" name="Send delay notice to banking system" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendLevel2Result" name="Send level 2 credit scoring result" messageRef="Msg_Level2ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level2ResultSent" name="Level 2 result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToLevel1" sourceRef="Start_ScoringRequestReceived" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Level1ToOutcome" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ImmediateResult" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="SendTask_SendLevel1Result">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${level1ResultAvailable}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LevelOneNotImmediate" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="SendTask_SendDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Level1ResultToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLevel1Result" targetRef="End_Level1ResultSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayToLevel2" sourceRef="SendTask_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Level2ToSend" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="SendTask_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Level2ResultToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_Level2ResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
